gap.missing_evidence: A reusable handover-duration measure with explicitly defined participants, operational start and stop, active-work versus elapsed interval, transfer-of-responsibility semantics, and overlap/concurrency treatment is unavailable. Zhu et al. report an observed mean for ED-intern task episodes but do not define these event endpoints or establish a transferable handover measure.
gap.owner: P1/P3 ED process and resource-evidence coordinator
gap.impact: The primary source Box 2 reports 13.1 minutes for 53 observed intern handover task episodes. This is source context only: it does not establish an all-role or cross-site handover duration, a distribution, transfer-of-responsibility endpoint, or simultaneous resource occupancy. No generic/Cairns handover value or fitted distribution is supported.
searches_performed: Inspected the bound primary source Zhu et al., MJA 2008;188(9):514-519, DOI 10.5694/j.1326-5377.2008.tb01765.x, PDF .artifacts/sources/p12-work/zhu-et-al-2008-mja.pdf, SHA-256 ef4338f3e397f42fdaf18f5dc9b13b4a5659d274b7e4cb118de66b28478b5498. Methods pp.514-515 describe prospective direct observation of 42 ED interns at three Melbourne public teaching hospitals in Aug-Dec 2006, using a stopwatch; where tasks were simultaneous only the principal activity was recorded. Box 2, printed p.516 (PDF p.3), Handover row reports 53 episodes, mean 13.1 minutes, 41 predicted episodes over eight 38-hour weeks, and 3.0% of intern time. No operational handover endpoints, named sender/receiver roles, responsibility-transfer rule, or overlap/occupancy measure is specified for that row.

Reviewed supplied R6 report 6 line 19 as secondary lineage only. It reports the same published mean/count and cautions that observed task means do not determine a distribution; it is not an independent primary measurement.

The bound packet and primary-source readback were the search scope; no additional search was performed. Publication access/reuse terms remain those of the MJA source; no licence granting reproduction of the PDF/table was established in this readback.
gap.next_action: If a handover interval is required, obtain a primary operational or observational source that defines participants, occurrence start/end, the responsibility-transfer point, active work versus elapsed time, interruptions and overlap/concurrency, plus population/site/period and denominator. Until then retain the parameter as unresolved; do not fit a distribution or infer all-role handover or simultaneous resource occupancy.
